findings.title: Wasm selected assessment choice lacks exposed browser selection state
findings.target: normal production Wasm; IAB; sampled sign-recognise-M7/rewrite-r2
findings.expected: The selected pending choice exposes a programmatic selected/checked state before confirmation, including after modal and leave-guard return.
findings.actual: Known wrong A is functionally retained and becomes Your answer/Incorrect with score0/1, but its pending DOM role is button and aria-checked/aria-selected/aria-pressed are absent. Pending AX does not announce selection.
reproduction: Cancel leave guard; enlarge/close option A
Confirm; compare Your answer A and correct D
findings.affected_surface: Assessment choice semantics at the browser accessibility bridge; root cause and wider affected set require10L1 triage.
findings.distinction: Android exposes checked/Selected but lacks persistent visible styling (DEF-10D-001). This finding concerns absent browser programmatic state, not spoken screen-reader listening.
findings.acceptance_check: Repeat pending selection/guard/viewer return on normal Wasm; selected state is exposed and matches the subsequently confirmed answer. Retest dependent required cases.
